subject: Post-call recap: Exec sponsor alignment & procurement path - AuroraMed
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Dr. Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@auroramed.com>, Kevin Huang <kevin.huang@auroramed.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap: Exec sponsor alignment & procurement path - AuroraMed

Thanks again for making time today — great conversation, Elena. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps to keep procurement moving. Please reply with any corrections or if you'd like me to loop additional stakeholders.

Key pain points we heard
- High per-request latency on current clinical-document summarization flows (esp. peak morning window) causing clinician wait time and partial fallbacks to manual summary.
- Rising inference cost as usage scales across three hospitals; billing predictability is a concern for leadership.
- Security/compliance checklist: SOC 2 evidence + data residency assurances required for procurement sign-off.

Desired business outcomes (executive view)
- Reduce median response time for summaries by ~60% to improve clinical throughput.
- Cut per-token inference cost by 30% via batching/caching/quantization recommendations and predictable reserved capacity.
- Maintain or improve accuracy for clinical extraction (no regression risk).

Procurement path & timing (as described today)
- Procurement will handle legal/SOW review and requires SOC 2 summary and a draft SOW to start.
- Target internal approval window: 6-8 weeks from SOW submission, budget cycle in mid-April.
- Primary procurement contact: Kevin Huang (cc'd).

Open risks / escalation items
- SOC 2 evidence: we provided summary today; procurement may ask for audit artifacts — we have the report and can provide redacted evidence under NDA.
- Pricing structure: if reserved capacity is needed, needs exec sign-off (VP Eng / CFO).

Next steps (owners + ETA)
1) Redwood -> Send draft SOW + SOC 2 summary for procurement review (action: marissa) — by Wed, 17 Feb EOD.
2) Redwood SE -> Technical appendix & deployment plan (action: aditya) — by Fri, 19 Feb.
3) AuroraMed -> Confirm procurement stakeholders and preferred legal reviewers (action: elena/kevin) — reply requested by Thu, 18 Feb.
4) Exec alignment call (10-20 min) with VP Eng + Elena to review outcomes/SLAs (action: laura to schedule) — propose week of 22 Feb.

Attachments: SOW-draft-v1.pdf (draft), SOC2-summary-2026.pdf (summary, redacted).

Thanks — happy to update items based on feedback.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. This aligns with my notes and is helpful for communicating to Sofia (VP Eng) and our procurement team. A couple of clarifications:

- Timeline: the 6-8 week window sounds right given our Q2 budget cadence. If we can get the SOW + SOC2 summary to Kevin and legal this week, that will keep us on track.
- Evidence: procurement will want the SOC2 cover letter + the sections on access controls and retention. If you can provide a redacted PDF that calls out those sections explicitly, that will speed review.

I'll introduce Sofia and our GC on the next reply once I confirm their availability for a short alignment call. Kevin — can you confirm who will review SOW/legal?
